Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and hematuria, with >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli cultured, indicating a urinary tract infection (UTI). The low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No ketones or casts are present. Findings are consistent with an acute bacterial UTI; clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
